task_decisions.decision: Determine movement actions (stay, move toward 0, move away) to synchronize position with other members of the same group so that all reach position 0 simultaneously.
locally_missing_information: Positions of other agents in the same group

task_decisions.decision: Determine when the entire group should attempt to finish (all members move to 0) to avoid finishing in the same round as the other group.
locally_missing_information: Active status of the other group
Positions of agents in the other group (to anticipate their finish readiness)

agent_groups.role_basis: Fixed group assignment from task configuration; agents in G1 must finish together in the same round, distinct from G2.
Fixed group assignment from task configuration; agents in G2 must finish together in the same round, distinct from G1.

information_requirements.fact: current_position of each agent in group G1
information_requirements.receiver_need_hypothesis: To know the distances of all G1 members from the target, enabling coordinated movement to reach 0 simultaneously.
uncertainties: Positions may become stale before the receiver acts due to communication delay and asynchronous action execution.

information_requirements.fact: current_position of each agent in group G2
information_requirements.receiver_need_hypothesis: To know the distances of all G2 members from the target, enabling coordinated movement to reach 0 simultaneously.
uncertainties: Positions may become stale before the receiver acts due to communication delay and asynchronous action execution.

information_requirements.receiver_need_hypothesis: To know when G1 has finished (active_status becomes 0), so that G2 can safely complete its own finish without causing a same-round conflict.
uncertainties: Active_status=1 indicates G1 is still active, but G1 could decide to finish at the same moment G2 does, leading to a simultaneous finish and penalty; simple status observation does not guarantee mutual exclusion.

information_requirements.receiver_need_hypothesis: To know when G2 has finished (active_status becomes 0), so that G1 can safely complete its own finish without causing a same-round conflict.
uncertainties: Active_status=1 indicates G2 is still active, but G2 could decide to finish at the same moment G1 does, leading to a simultaneous finish and penalty; simple status observation does not guarantee mutual exclusion.

information_requirements.fact: current_position of each agent in group G1
information_requirements.receiver_need_hypothesis: To estimate the collective distance of the other group from the target and better anticipate when they might attempt to finish, reducing risk of simultaneous finishes.
uncertainties: Exact finish timing depends on future actions; positional proximity does not guarantee immediate finish, especially if agents deliberately delay.

information_requirements.fact: current_position of each agent in group G2

uncertainties: Exact finish timing depends on future actions; positional proximity does not guarantee immediate finish, especially if agents deliberately delay.
